name: SearchAddress
summary: React address search input with OpenStreetMap Nominatim autocomplete, grouped results and debounced queries.
description: An address autocomplete component built with React, shadcn/ui components and lucide-react icons, backed by the Nominatim geocoding service from OpenStreetMap via leaflet-geosearch. Suggestions appear in a popover, grouped by address type, and can be selected by click or touch; the repo also ships useDebounce and useSearchAddress hooks.
contains: autocomplete search that suggests addresses as you type
popover result list, selectable by click or touch
debounced input via a useDebounce hook
useSearchAddress hook wraps search logic and state
Nominatim/OpenStreetMap endpoint; multiple providers through leaflet-geosearch
